extract_eye_at_up_from_camera: extract the eye, at, and up vectors from a PyTorch3D camera's world to view transform
rotate_camera_on_spot: rotate a PyTorch3D camera in place by a given rotation matrix without changing its position
batch_cameras_together: join a list of PyTorch3D camera objects into a single batched cameras object
review_camera_to_eye_at_up: review the camera_to_eye_at_up function which converts a world to view transform into eye, at, and up vectors
refactor_rotate_on_spot: refactor the rotate_on_spot function to support additional rotation formats beyond 3x3 matrices
